selection: best validation PSNR (valid split of PanCollection)
train_note: training runs in segments of at most 48 h; continue an interrupted run with the same command plus --resume. The recipe is the method's published one, identical for the three arms.
infer: python scripts/infer.py --method PAN-Crafter --arm original --train-set qb --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PAN-Crafter/original/qb_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method PAN-Crafter --arm original --train-set qb --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PAN-Crafter/original/qb_full
runtime_note: needs ctx['lpan'], the MS-resolution low-pass PAN distributed with the upstream repository; WorldView-2 has none, the table synthesises it (lpan_synth.lpan_from_pan).
inference_seed: torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each test image
